title: Affine ind-etale charts under binary pullback along an affine-open refinement
statement: Let U,V,P,A,D be schemes, b:U → V and p:P → U. Let i:A → U be an open immersion with A affine, and let r:D → A be affine pro-etale. Suppose P has a small open cover T_beta by affine schemes, and each composite T_beta → P → U → V factors as an affine pro-etale map to an affine open W_beta of V followed by its inclusion. Then P ×_U D, formed using p and r followed by i, has a small open cover E_gamma by affine schemes whose composites to V likewise factor through affine opens by affine pro-etale maps. All factorization equalities use the first projection to P. No quasi-compactness, separatedness or surjectivity is required.

source.place: Proposition 2.3.3(4) and Remark 4.1.3; affine-local pullback step 4 of lem-sfb-weakly-etale-indetale-cech-refinement.

proof.text: Form Q=P ×_U A. Pull back the given cover T of P to Q, then apply its affine refinement S. Since A → U is an open immersion, each S_gamma → T_beta is an open immersion between affine schemes, hence affine pro-etale. Retain the selected target W_beta and compose its pro-affine-etale map with this open immersion. All indices remain in the prescribed universe.

Pull the affine cover S back along Q ×_A D → Q. Its components are S_gamma ×_A D. The projection to S_gamma is affine pro-etale by affine base change; it is affine because its source is the pullback of affine schemes over the affine scheme A. Compose with S_gamma → T_beta → W_beta. The pullback-pasting isomorphism (P ×_U A) ×_A D ≅ P ×_U D transports this open cover. The pullback projection identities prove each claimed equality to V.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 2.3.3(4) and Remark 4.1.3; Q6 implements the local argument with pullback open covers and pullback-pasting.

theorem exists_affine_indEtale_pullback_charts
    {U V P A D : Scheme.{u}} (b : U ⟶ V) (p : P ⟶ U)
    (i : A ⟶ U) [IsAffine A] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (r : D ⟶ A) (hr : proAffineEtale r)
    (T : Scheme.OpenCover.{u} P)
    (hT : ∀ β : T.I₀, IsAffine (T.X β) ∧
      ∃ (W : V.Opens) (_hW : IsAffineOpen W) (g : T.X β ⟶ W.toScheme),
        proAffineEtale g ∧ g ≫ W.ι = T.f β ≫ p ≫ b) :
    ∃ E : Scheme.OpenCover.{u} (pullback p (r ≫ i)),
      ∀ β : E.I₀, IsAffine (E.X β) ∧
        ∃ (W : V.Opens) (_hW : IsAffineOpen W) (g : E.X β ⟶ W.toScheme),
          proAffineEtale g ∧
          g ≫ W.ι = E.f β ≫ pullback.fst p (r ≫ i) ≫ p ≫ b
